failure_reason: Akamai bot-management returns HTTP 403 'Restricted Access' on every /shop/* PLP URL tested, confirmed independently across all 3 access tiers: (1) curl_cffi with Chrome-120 TLS impersonation, both cold and with a warmed session (homepage cookies + same-origin Referer/Sec-Fetch headers); (2) Playwright, both headless Chromium and headful real-Chrome channel; (3) a live Claude-in-Chrome browser session (navigating from the already-loaded, working homepage). All three returned the same 'Pottery Barn Kids: 403 - Restricted Access' page. Only the homepage (/), /robots.txt, the sitemap XML files under /netstorage/sitemaps/, and /llms.txt (all outside /shop/) returned HTTP 200. This matches the prior Furniture-pass note for this company (archive c5) exactly. r.jina.ai / translate.goog / archive.org were not used per this task's rules, so no PLP content or product count could be verified this pass.
notes: Main nav 'Sale' -> https://www.potterybarnkids.com/shop/sale/ is a GENERIC sale hub per llms.txt (title 'Baby & Kids Sale', description mentions general sale items across departments, no permanence/outlet signal) -- per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test this generic parent page is EXCLUDED, not classified as Clearance. However, enumerating shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz under the same /shop/sale/* branch surfaced an extensive, explicitly '-clearance'-labeled sub-taxonomy (15 URLs, listed as rows below) that is clearly distinct from the many LTO/seasonal-sale/redline-event/mega-sale/valentines-lto/disney-princess-lto style promo pages also found in that branch (those remain excluded as generic temporary promotions). Two candidate 'All Clearance' rollup URLs exist in the sitemap: /shop/sale/shop-all-clearance/ and /shop/sale/all-clearance/ -- likely a nav-alias vs. facet-generated duplicate of the same listing; kept all-clearance/ as the row (naming matches the all-baby-clearance/all-kids-clearance sibling pattern) and flagged the possible alias rather than emitting two unverifiable duplicate rows. No Clearance-specific page could be opened (Akamai 403 on all 3 access tiers), so all qty values are null.

rows.evidence: URL present in shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz, explicitly named 'all-clearance' inside the /shop/sale/ branch, sibling to all-baby-clearance/all-kids-clearance/department-clearance pages. The site's own taxonomy clearly separates these clearance-labeled pages from generic sale/LTO/promo pages in the same /shop/sale/ branch (e.g. seasonal-sale, redline-event-bedroom-furniture, mega-baby-bedding, advent-sale, holiday-sale, all-free-shipping are NOT clearance-labeled and are excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance test). Parent /shop/sale/ itself is a generic 'Baby & Kids Sale' page per llms.txt and is excluded.
